92mm PET Cups: 200ml to 500ml Catalog Size Chart

Article Quick Facts

Catalog series
92mm PET
Listed capacities
200 / 260 / 340 / 350 / 400 / 420 / 500ml
Listed weights
7 / 8 / 10 / 10 / 11 / 11.5 / 13.5g
Carton quantity
1,000 pcs per listed model

Choose a Model, Not Only a Caliber

The current PET catalog has seven 92mm-series cup rows, with listed capacities from 200ml to 500ml. The series name is 92mm, while the first number in each listed dimension string is 93mm. The supplied data do not explain this difference; do not infer a rim tolerance or lid specification from it. Request the final factory drawing and sample for the exact model.

92mm PET Cup Catalog Rows

The dimensions below reproduce the catalog strings without assigning an unverified order to the measurements. Weights and carton quantities are also catalog values, not production tolerances or minimum order quantities.

Why the 340ml and 350ml Rows Need Separate Checks

The 92-340 PET and 92-350 PET rows both list 10g, but their catalog dimensions differ: 93 × 91 × 58mm versus 93 × 80 × 67mm. A shared weight does not establish identical cup geometry, usable fill level or closure fit. Compare the model codes and request separate drawings and samples if both are being considered.

What to Include in a Supplier Inquiry

Quote the exact catalog model, its listed capacity, dimension string, weight and 1,000-piece carton quantity. Ask the factory to confirm the dimension order and tolerance, actual rim profile, matched lid or sealing film, usable fill level, temperature rating, food-contact documents, printing, MOQ, price and lead time. Those details are 待工厂确认; carton quantity is not an MOQ. See the current PET catalog for other sizes and compare the 90mm and 95mm series separately.

Article FAQs

Which 92mm PET capacities are listed?

The current catalog lists 200ml, 260ml, 340ml, 350ml, 400ml, 420ml and 500ml models in this series.

Why do the dimension strings start with 93mm?

The catalog labels this series 92mm but lists dimension strings starting with 93mm. The reason and exact rim specification are 待工厂确认; request a final drawing and sample.

Do all seven models have the same carton quantity?

Each of the seven supplied rows lists 1,000 pcs per carton. MOQ and final packing configuration are 待工厂确认.

Can a lid be selected from the 92mm label alone?

No. Rim profile and lid or sealing-film fit are 待工厂确认 for the exact cup model; test a physical cup-and-closure sample.
